description: Detailed waypoint notes for established expedition routes. Written by the Courier, the Hunter, and expedition leaders. Each route includes waypoints, hazards, water sources, and shelter options.

routes.name: South Ridge to Frozen River
routes.author: the_courier

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head south along the concrete apron.
waypoints.hazards: None. Clear line of sight to the ridge.

waypoints.description: South perimeter marker (painted concrete post). Turn southeast toward the ridge.
waypoints.hazards: Ash depth increases to 20cm. Watch for hidden debris under the ash.

waypoints.description: Ridge crest. Follow the ridge southeast. The ridge provides a clear path with minimal ash accumulation.
waypoints.hazards: Wind exposure. In an ash storm, descend to the west side of the ridge for shelter.

waypoints.description: Descent from ridge to the frozen river valley. The descent is steep (30 degrees) and the ash is loose.
waypoints.hazards: Slip hazard. Ankle-deep ash on the descent. Use the exposed rock on the east side for traction.

waypoints.description: Frozen river bank. The fishing spot is 50m upstream (east) where the ice is thickest.
waypoints.hazards: Ice thickness varies. Test before walking on. Radiation reading: 28 uSv/h.
waypoints.shelter: River bank (wind shelter from the valley walls).

routes.water_sources: Frozen river (must be melted and treated). No liquid water on route.
routes.radiation_notes: Background 0.9 uSv/h at bunker, rising to 45 uSv/h at south perimeter, dropping to 28 uSv/h at the river. Total exposure for a round trip: approximately 120 uSv.

routes.name: East Ridge to Geo-thermal Plant (EXCLUDED)
routes.author: the_hunter

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head east toward the ridge.
waypoints.hazards: None initially.

waypoints.description: East ridge approach. Ash depth 30cm. Radiation climbing.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 80 uSv/h. Time limit: 30 minutes at this range without full hazmat.

waypoints.description: East ridge crest. Radiation: 120 uSv/h. The geo-thermal plant is visible to the east — steam rising from multiple vents.
waypoints.hazards: EXTREME radiation. Full hazmat required. No exposed skin. Gas mask mandatory. Time limit: 15 minutes.
waypoints.shelter: None. The steam vents provide wind shelter but increase inhalation risk.

waypoints.description: Geo-thermal plant perimeter. DO NOT APPROACH WITHIN 500m. Radiation: 350 uSv/h.
waypoints.hazards: LETHAL without full hazmat. The area is permanently excluded. No expedition should approach.

routes.water_sources: None. The geo-thermal steam is contaminated. Do not drink.
routes.radiation_notes: This route is EXCLUDED. The geo-thermal plant area is lethally contaminated. No expedition should be sent here under any circumstances. The route is documented for reference only.

routes.name: North Trail to Dead Oak Cache
routes.author: the_courier

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head north along the old road.
waypoints.hazards: None. The road is clear of major debris.

waypoints.description: Road junction. Take the left fork (north-northwest). The right fork leads to a collapsed bridge over a dry creek.
waypoints.hazards: None.
waypoints.shelter: Collapsed building on the right (partial roof, wind shelter only).

waypoints.description: Dead oak tree (large, distinctive). The cache is at the base of the tree — a sealed container buried under 10cm of ash.
waypoints.hazards: None. The area is low radiation (15 uSv/h).
waypoints.shelter: The dead oak provides wind shelter. The cache container is large enough to shelter under in an emergency.

waypoints.description: Cache contents verified. Return via the same route.
waypoints.hazards: None.

routes.water_sources: None on route. Carry minimum 2 litres per person.
routes.radiation_notes: Low radiation throughout. Background to 15 uSv/h at the cache. This is the safest surface route from the bunker.

routes.name: West Traverse to The Allotments
routes.author: the_courier

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head west along the ridge.
waypoints.hazards: None initially.

waypoints.description: Western ridge descent. The descent is gradual but the ash is deep (25cm).
waypoints.hazards: Ash depth. Watch for hidden holes under the ash.

waypoints.description: Midpoint rest stop. An abandoned farmhouse with partial roof. The interior is contaminated but the exterior walls provide wind shelter.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 35 uSv/h. Do not enter the farmhouse. Rest against the exterior wall.

waypoints.description: Approach to The Allotments. Cultivated fields visible (irradiated but tended). A fence line marks the settlement boundary.
waypoints.hazards: Challenge from settlement sentries. Approach openly with hands visible.

waypoints.description: The Allotments settlement. Population approximately 30. Trade goods: dried vegetables, grain. They need medical supplies.
waypoints.hazards: None within the settlement. The settlement is friendly.

routes.water_sources: Settlement well at The Allotments (tested, safe). Carry water for the outward journey (4 hours without water).
routes.radiation_notes: Moderate throughout. Peak 35 uSv/h at the midpoint. Total round-trip exposure: approximately 250 uSv. This is a full-day expedition.

routes.name: Southeast Approach to Shallows Market
routes.author: the_hunter

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head southeast along the old highway.
waypoints.hazards: Highway is debris-filled. Navigate around wrecked vehicles.

waypoints.description: Highway pileup (location: highway_pileup). A massive traffic jam of abandoned vehicles. Navigate through the gap on the east shoulder.
waypoints.hazards: Unstable vehicles. Radiation: 25 uSv/h. Do not enter the vehicles (contamination).
waypoints.shelter: Under the overpass (wind and radiation shelter).

waypoints.description: Midpoint. An abandoned service station. The station has a concrete canopy that provides excellent shelter.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 30 uSv/h. The station interior is contaminated. Rest under the canopy.

waypoints.description: Descent to the lake. The lake is visible — a grey expanse surrounded by dead trees. The Shallows Market is built on stilts over the shallow end of the lake.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 20 uSv/h (the lake water dilutes contamination). Approach from the north causeway.

waypoints.description: Shallows Market. Population approximately 60. Trade goods: dried fish, lamp oil, matches. They need antibiotics and bandages.
waypoints.hazards: None within the settlement. The settlement is built over water and is relatively clean.

routes.water_sources: Lake water (must be treated — see water quality reports). Settlement has a rainwater collection system.
routes.radiation_notes: This is a two-day expedition. Overnight at the service station (Day 1) and return on Day 2. Total exposure: approximately 400 uSv. Full hazmat recommended for the first 6 km.

routes.name: Underground Transit Tunnel (East)
routes.author: Golf-1 (new arrival, former tunnel dweller)

waypoints.description: Access via the sub-level transit entrance (maintenance hatch in the bunker sub-basement). The tunnel is 2m wide, 3m high, concrete-lined.
waypoints.hazards: Darkness. Carry a light. The tunnel is dry but cold (8 degrees C year-round).

waypoints.description: First junction. Left branch goes to the old metro station (flooded). Right branch continues east. Take the right.
waypoints.hazards: The left branch water level is chest-high. Do not enter without wading equipment.

waypoints.description: Mushroom garden. Golf-1 cultivated mushrooms here during his 2 years in the tunnels. The mushrooms are still growing. They are safe to eat (tested).
waypoints.hazards: None. The mushrooms are non-toxic and non-radioactive.
waypoints.shelter: The mushroom garden is dry and has a flat area for resting.

waypoints.description: Collapse. The tunnel ahead is blocked by a roof fall. The collapse is recent (within 6 months). The rubble is passable but requires climbing.
waypoints.hazards: Unstable rubble. Do not proceed alone. The collapse may extend further.

waypoints.description: Surface access shaft (collapsed). The shaft is blocked but air is flowing from above — this connects to the surface. The shaft could be cleared with effort.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation from above: 40 uSv/h. The shaft is not a viable exit without clearing.

routes.water_sources: Condensation on tunnel walls (collectable). A small seepage stream at the 3km mark (water is clean, tested).
routes.radiation_notes: Very low throughout. Background 0.2 uSv/h in the tunnel. The underground route provides excellent radiation shielding. This could be an alternative evacuation route if cleared.

routes.name: South Perimeter Patrol Route
routes.author: the_general

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. The patrol route is a 1.5km circuit around the bunker perimeter at 200m distance.
waypoints.hazards: None. The route is well-travelled and clear.

waypoints.description: South perimeter marker. Check the marker post for damage. Check the ash depth (should be under 25cm).
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Southeast corner. Check for animal tracks. Report any sign of approach toward the bunker.
waypoints.hazards: Occasional animal tracks (mutated canids). No human sign.

waypoints.description: East perimeter. Check the long-wire antenna (attached to the dead oak 200m south). The antenna should be visible from here.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Return to bunker hatch. Report any observations to the General.
waypoints.hazards: None.

routes.radiation_notes: Low. Background to 45 uSv/h at the perimeter. Total exposure for a patrol: approximately 60 uSv. This is a routine daily task.

routes.name: North Ridge to Seed Vault Antechamber
routes.author: the_hunter

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head north along the ridge.
waypoints.hazards: None initially.

waypoints.description: North ridge crest. Follow the ridge north. The path is clear but exposed.
waypoints.hazards: Wind exposure. In an ash storm, descend to the west side.

waypoints.description: Descent from ridge into the valley. The seed vault entrance is visible — a concrete structure built into the hillside.
waypoints.hazards: The descent is steep. Watch for loose rock.
waypoints.shelter: Valley floor (wind shelter from the hills).

waypoints.description: Seed vault antechamber entrance (location: location_seed_vault_antechamber). The door is sealed but not locked. The interior is cool and dry.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 5 uSv/h (the vault is well-shielded). The interior is clean.

waypoints.description: Seed vault interior. The seed samples are stored in sealed containers in a cold room. The Botanist has collected samples on previous expeditions. The vault is a valuable resource.
waypoints.hazards: None. The vault is clean and safe.

routes.water_sources: A small spring at the base of the hill (200m east of the vault). The water is clean (tested).
routes.radiation_notes: Low throughout. The seed vault is well-shielded by the hillside and concrete construction. This is a valuable route for seed collection and emergency shelter.

routes.name: Emergency Evacuation Route (South)
routes.author: the_general

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Head south at speed. This route is for emergency evacuation only.
waypoints.hazards: None initially. Move fast.

waypoints.description: South ridge crest. Continue south. Do not stop.
waypoints.hazards: Exposed. If under pursuit, use the ridge for observation before descending.

waypoints.description: Descent to the dry creek bed. The creek bed provides cover from observation.
waypoints.hazards: The creek bed is debris-filled. Navigate carefully.

waypoints.description: Creek bed junction. Turn east. Follow the creek for 1km to the rally point.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Rally point: an abandoned concrete culvert (large enough for 47 people to shelter). The culvert is marked with a painted arrow on the interior wall. Emergency supplies are cached here (see Dead Oak Cache route for resupply).
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 30 uSv/h. The culvert is sheltered but not sealed.
waypoints.shelter: Concrete culvert (emergency shelter for up to 48 hours).

routes.water_sources: None on route. Emergency water caches at the rally point (40 litres, sealed).
routes.radiation_notes: Moderate. This route is designed for speed, not safety. Total exposure: approximately 200 uSv. The culvert is a temporary shelter — long-term residence is not viable.

routes.name: Greenhouse to Compost Bay (Internal)
routes.author: the_botanist

waypoints.description: Greenhouse exit. Walk through the east wing corridor.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Compost Bay. Deposit kitchen waste, greenhouse plant waste, and compost toilet material. Collect finished compost for the greenhouse beds.
waypoints.hazards: The compost is hot (55 degrees C in the core). Do not insert hands into the active pile. Wear gloves.

routes.water_sources: None needed. This is an internal route.

routes.name: Bunker to Cemetery (Eastern Field)
routes.author: the_undertaker

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. Walk east across the concrete apron.
waypoints.hazards: None. The path is clear.

waypoints.description: Cemetery. The eastern field cemetery contains 23 graves. Each grave is marked with a cross or stone. The Undertaker tends the cemetery weekly.
waypoints.hazards: Radiation: 35 uSv/h. The cemetery is on the surface. Limit time to 30 minutes per visit.
waypoints.shelter: The cemetery has a small shelter (stone wall, roof) for the Undertaker to use during visits.

routes.radiation_notes: Moderate. The cemetery is on the surface and exposed. The Undertaker wears a dosimeter and gas mask during visits. Total exposure per visit: approximately 15 uSv.

routes.name: Bunker to Surface Antenna (Maintenance)
routes.author: the_electrician

waypoints.description: Bunker hatch exit. The antenna is mounted on the surface mast 50m from the hatch, with the long-wire extending 200m south to the dead oak.
waypoints.hazards: None initially.

waypoints.description: Surface mast base. Climb the mast (10m) to access the antenna connection point. The mast has ladder rungs welded to it.
waypoints.hazards: Fall hazard. Wear a safety harness (the Tailor made one from webbing). Radiation: 40 uSv/h at mast height.

waypoints.description: Dead oak (antenna anchor). Check the wire tension and insulator condition. The wire is copper and may need replacement every 6 months.
waypoints.hazards: The tree is dead and may drop branches. Do not stand under the tree for extended periods.

routes.water_sources: None. This is a short maintenance trip.
routes.radiation_notes: Moderate. Total exposure per maintenance visit: approximately 30 uSv. The Electrician visits monthly.

routes.name: Internal Bunker Route (Medical Bay to Kitchen)
routes.author: the_architect

waypoints.description: Medical bay exit. Turn left into the main corridor.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Pass the workshop (right). Continue straight.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Kitchen entrance. The kitchen is on the left side of the corridor.
waypoints.hazards: None.

routes.name: Internal Bunker Route (Dormitory to Generator Room)
routes.author: the_electrician

waypoints.description: Dormitory exit. Turn right into the main corridor. Head down (sub-level).
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Sub-level corridor. The generator room is at the end.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Generator room entrance. The door requires the combination (known to the Electrician and the General).
waypoints.hazards: None.

routes.radiation_notes: Background to 1.5 uSv/h at the generator room. No concern for short visits.

routes.name: Full Bunker Perimeter Circuit (Internal)
routes.author: the_general

waypoints.description: Main corridor junction. The circuit follows the outer wall of the bunker, passing every section.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Dormitory section. Check the acoustic baffles. Check the bunk assignments.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Kitchen and greenhouse section. Check the food stores. Check the greenhouse status.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Medical bay and workshop section. Check the medical supplies. Check the workshop inventory.
waypoints.hazards: None.

waypoints.description: Generator room and blast door section. Check the generator status. Check the blast door mechanism. Return to main junction.
waypoints.hazards: None.

routes.water_sources: Available at multiple points throughout the bunker.
routes.radiation_notes: Background throughout. This is the General daily inspection route. It is walked every morning.
